compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

`rebar.opcert_service.jobs.run_job` starts 34-60 git processes per job (measured 2026-11-03 on the macOS dev host; 34 for a FAIL verdict, 60 for a signed PASS). On that host each git exec costs 0.11-0.33 s median and up to 1.3 s under load, about 95% of it outside git's own runtime (GIT_TRACE2: 25 `git --version` runs = 5.89 s wall vs 0.31 s inside git). A job therefore spends 7-14 s mostly waiting on process startup, not doing work. Discovered while fixing deformed-cherubical-flycatcher, where these tests ran past the 300 s per-test budget; that ticket removed the test-side share (about 52 processes per test) and left this production share.

## Measurements (dev host, load average about 30-40)

- `test_completion_pass_binds_server_derived_values`: `run_job` 60 spawns, 14.1 s.
- `test_completion_fail_completes_with_null_envelope`: `run_job` 34 spawns, 7.1 s.
- cProfile of one completion-PASS job (`test_server_never_pushes_and_workspace_is_isolated`, `run_job` 19.1 s): `opcert_service/workspace.py:_populate` 8.3 s and `jobs._dispatch_completion` 7.7 s. `_populate` issues about 16 git calls itself (init, 2 remote add, 2 fetch, checkout, rev-parse, 6 config, worktree add, 2 remote remove) and then runs `rebar._store.ensures.run_ensures` on the mounted tracker; the split between those 2 was not measured.

## Approach (proposal; needs plan review)

Reduce the git process count per job without changing what is signed or the no-push guarantee: e.g. set identity/gpgsign through one `git -c`/config file write instead of 6 `git config` calls, fetch both refs in one fetch, and skip ensure steps that are no-ops on a tracker just fetched from an authoritative store. Each removal must keep `tests/unit/test_opcert_service*.py` green, including the no-push and server-derived-binding assertions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A test counts subprocess spawns inside `jobs.run_job` for a completion PASS on a test store and asserts a ceiling at least 40% below the 60 measured here.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_opcert_service.py tests/unit/test_opcert_service_integrity.py` passes unchanged in its assertions.
- [ ] Wall time of those 2 modules on the dev host is recorded before and after, with the load average.
compiled_state.title: Opcert run_job starts 34-60 git processes per job
